subject: P0: Meridian Health AZ fabric degradation — request to reroute traffic and exec approval
messages:
From: Sam Trask <sam.trask@meridianhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Health SRE <ops@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: P0 — spike: 5xx + token queueing in us-east-1 for Meridian Health

Hi Olga,

We're seeing a sharp spike in 5xx (502/504) responses and token queueing starting ~07:30 UTC this morning for our Meridian Health production traffic routed to us-east-1 AZs. Latency has doubled and error rate is impacting our patient-facing flows. Our SREs attached a short log snapshot (meridian_error_snapshot.log) and we have an open INC ticket: INC-12249.

Can Redwood initiate an emergency reroute or recommend an immediate mitigation? Our business impact is high — some elective patient workflows are timing out. Please advise next steps and whether a cross-region failover is possible without data loss.

Sam Trask
Head of Platform Ops, Meridian Health
sam.trask@meridianhealth.com

--
Attachment: meridian_error_snapshot.log (text/log, 34KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Trask <sam.trask@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Meridian Health SRE <ops@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: P0 — spike: 5xx + token queueing in us-east-1 for Meridian Health

Sam — thanks for the heads up and the log. We're looking now. Quick answers up front: yes, we can perform a transient cross-region reroute to us-west-2 and run a gradual traffic shift (canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) to reduce pressure on the affected AZs. We'll coordinate a 30-minute maintenance window for the shift and monitor KV cache warming and any regression.

Before we do the reroute we need:
- Meridian confirmation that you approve a transient reroute to us-west-2 (we will keep session affinity where possible and invalidate short-lived caches).
- Executive approval for transient routing + authority to apply a one-time customer credit if SLAs are impacted by current error window (finance needs a sign-off for >$X credits).

I'm looping in Marissa and Rishi to scope the operational runbook and the credit ask. I'll prepare the reroute_playbook.md (attached) and deploy the canary at 08:45 UTC if we get approvals.

Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Reliability Manager — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

--

Hannah / Sean —

Quick summary: Meridian Health production is experiencing a regional fabric degradation in us-east-1 (likely AZ-level) causing elevated 5xx and sustained token queue depth. Customer-impacting. Olga has recommended a transient cross-region reroute to us-west-2 (canary ramp) at ~08:45 UTC. Expected mitigation: reduce queue depth and immediate latency improvement; risk: cache warming mismatch and short-term 429s while sessions stabilize.

Asks:
1) Exec approval to perform the transient reroute now (Olga will coordinate ops).
2) Authorization to offer a one-time goodwill credit up to $15k if post-shift telemetry shows continued errors attributable to our routing. Procurement/finance will need this sign-off so we can commit publicly.
3) Confirm comms: I propose a single customer-facing update after canary shows improvement and an internal postmortem within 72h.

Attached: reroute_playbook.md (ops steps) and current incident ticket INC-12249.

If you approve I will: notify Legal/Finance/CS, prepare the customer update copy, and start the shift at 08:45 UTC.

-Marissa

Subject: ACTION: initiating transient reroute to us-west-2 (canary) — Meridian Health

Sam — thanks for the quick confirmation earlier on the phone. Per exec approval, we're initiating the canary reroute at 08:50 UTC to us-west-2. Plan: 5-minute canary (5% traffic), evaluate metrics (5xx, p95 latency, token queue depth), then 25% -> 50% -> 100% if stable. We'll hold at any step if 5xx increases >1.5x baseline or if p95 worsens.

Timeline:
- 08:50 UTC: canary (5%) deployed to us-west-2
- 08:56 UTC: metrics check; decision to continue to 25%
- 09:10 UTC: planned full shift by 09:25 UTC if stable

Prelim results: initial canary shows p95 latency down ~38% and 5xx count dropping from 18/min to 4/min (first 6 minutes). We will keep you posted. Postmortem draft will be shared within 72 hours.

Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Reliability Manager — Redwood Inference
